C2.why: Medi used the bare form أحب without the b- prefix, and Amal recast it as بحب.

C3.why: Speech-to-text misheard his pronunciation of أغلب as أكل (even after Amal understood 'Most of' and prompted 'Most of شو؟').

C4.why: Medi used هو (he) instead of همّ (they) before عندهم, and Amal recast it as همّ عندهم.

C5.why: Medi omitted the definite article el- on أكل عربي in a general comparison, and Amal prompted him until he fixed it to الأكل العربي.

C6.why: The audio is garbled by STT ('ما zum'), and Amal is prompting the target verb she wants him to use, which leads into C7.

C7.why: Medi used the t- prefix (matehtaj) instead of first-person b- for 'I don't need', and Amal recast it as بحتاج.

C8.why: Medi added the first-person object suffix -ni (استنني 'wait for me') when translating 'wait for the next flight', and Amal corrected it.

C9.why: Duplicate of C8 (Medi asking at 17:24 what he had said earlier) and C10 (adjective placement at 17:43).

C10.why: Medi put the adjective الجاية before the noun, and Amal stopped him to remind him that adjectives go after the noun.

C11.why: Medi put the object pronoun 'them' on the preposition (عليهم) instead of the verb (اعزميهم على), and Amal explicitly rejected it.

C12.why: Medi used سأل (ask a question) instead of طلب (request/ask for), and Amal explicitly rejected it.

C13.why: Medi formed the command as طلبي (Thalabi), and Amal prompted 'Fix the command' until he said اطلبي.

C14.why: Medi used the present tense ما تجاوبي for 'you didn't answer', and Amal prompted 'Past' so he fixed it to ما جاوبتي.

C15.why: Medi mixed the two constructions for 'my last question' as السؤال الأخير إلي, and Amal rejected it as a mixed way to say it.

C16.why: Medi put آخر before a definite noun (آخر السؤال), and Amal corrected him by explaining that means 'the end of'.

C17.why: Medi dropped the b- prefix on the present verb (نرن) after صارلنا, and Amal recast it as بنرن.

C18.why: Medi attached the object suffix directly to the verb (برنك) instead of using the required preposition عليك, and Amal said 'No'.

C19.why: Medi used عليّ instead of لي after تبعتي for 'sending me', and Amal rejected it.

C20.why: Medi confused بدأ (start, with d) and بعت (send, with t), and Amal corrected him ('No D. Babat.').

C25.why: Duplicate of C24 describing the exact same conjugation slip on ما تتأسفي.

C26.why: Medi omitted the preposition before the question word شو, and Amal reminded him he was missing the first step.

C27.why: Medi used the preposition عن instead of من with the verb شكى, and Amal corrected it to من.

C29.why: Medi tried مني and عليّ with اشتقتي instead of the required preposition لـ (اشتقتيلي), and Amal rejected both.
